tips.label: 情緒形容詞
tips.text: V-ing 描述事物「令人……」；過去分詞描述人「感到……」。

tips.label: that 名詞子句
tips.text: that 可引導完整句子，作動詞受詞、主詞或補語。

notes.title: 情緒動詞與形容詞
notes.description: bore、excite、interest、surprise、tire 等動詞表示使人產生感受。

notes.title: 現在分詞與過去分詞
notes.description: 現在分詞修飾造成感受的事物；過去分詞修飾感受的人。

notes.title: 過去分詞的介系詞
notes.description: 不同的情緒形容詞常搭配固定介系詞。
examples: I am interested in the app.
We were excited about the trip.

notes.title: that 引導名詞子句
notes.description: that 子句可作動詞受詞，that 常可省略；作主詞時不可省略，視為單數。
examples: I think (that) the app is useful.
That the app is useful is true.

notes.title: that 子句作補語
notes.rule: 主詞＋be 動詞＋that＋完整子句
notes.description: that 子句可放在 be 動詞或形容詞後補充說明。
examples: The problem is that nobody can drive.
It is surprising that he knows this.

quiz.question: The long walk was very ___.

quiz.question: I know the reason ___ he is late.
quiz.hint: reason 後可接 that 子句說明原因。

quiz.question: The discount makes the app more ___.
quiz.hint: app 是令人感興趣的事物，用 interesting。

quiz.question: That he wears a uniform ___ important.

quiz.question: Please tap the green ___.

quiz.question: The app can find your ___.
quiz.hint: App 可以找到你的位置，用 location。

quiz.question: I don't mind ___ you use my phone.
quiz.hint: mind 後可接 that 子句。

quiz.question: The result was ___ to all of us.
quiz.hint: result 是令人驚訝的事物，用 surprising。

quiz.question: He was ___ at the answer.
quiz.hint: he 是感到驚訝的人，用 surprised at。

quiz.question: At least, give me a ___ to try.
quiz.hint: 給某人機會是 give someone a chance。

quiz.question: The food is popular ___ young people.
quiz.hint: among 表示「在……之中」。

quiz.question: The page offers ___ useful tips.
quiz.hint: at least 表示至少。

quiz.question: I believe ___ the driver can help us.
quiz.hint: believe 後面接完整子句，用 that。

quiz.question: The driver looks ___ after the long day.
quiz.hint: driver 是感到疲倦的人，用過去分詞 tired。

quiz.question: It is helpful ___ the list is clear.
quiz.hint: 形容詞 helpful 後可接 that 子句補充說明。
